# Queue POP3 clients until the prior run completes

The May 2024 POP3 change serializes client runs across accounts through withClient and a completion queue. A fixed timeout was rejected because a slow run can still be writing to the same inbox when the next starts. Free the queue from the actual client completion path.

Scope: POP3 connections.

Paths:

- `mailnews/local/src/Pop3IncomingServer.sys.mjs`
